description: Search the aitools.obzdn.co directory of AI and open-source tools for owner-operators and small teams. Returns up to `limit` tools with what each does, who it fits, starting price, the catch to watch for, and links.

audience.description: Optional: trades (trades and home services), local (gyms, salons, studios, shops), pros (consultants, agencies, freelancers), creators

category.description: Optional category id, e.g. missed-calls, estimates, scheduling, bookkeeping, reviews, field-photos, inbox, sales-followup, content, lead-gen, admin-docs

max_monthly_usd.description: Optional: only tools whose starting price is at or under this many dollars

open_source_only.description: Optional: only free and open-source tools

query.description: What the business needs, in plain words, e.g. 'answer missed calls for a plumber'

name: search_tools
title: Search AI tools for small businesses
